$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：破軍獨坐寅申，《深造講義》p.45。

rules.text: 順從性較重的破軍，人生變動的幅度較小，馬鞍形的起落也較平緩。
rules.en: When Po Jun leans towards going with the flow, life's changes are smaller and the saddle-shaped rises and falls are gentler.

source.quote: 破军的顺从性愈强，人生的变动幅度愈小

rules.text: 叛逆性較重的破軍，人生變動的幅度較大，馬鞍形的起落也較明顯。
rules.en: When Po Jun leans towards rebellion, life's changes are bigger and the saddle-shaped rises and falls are sharper.

source.quote: 破军的叛逆性愈强，人生的变动幅度愈大

rules.text: 順從的破軍稍有成就就容易自滿；你的盤又見鈴星或陀羅，更容易停在原地，難以再上一層。
rules.en: A Po Jun that goes with the flow tends to grow complacent after a little success; with Ling Xing or Tuo Luo in your chart, it's even easier to stall and hard to climb further.

source.quote: 最不宜见铃星、陀罗，见则更停滞不前

rules.text: 順從的破軍略見火星或擎羊，反而能激發你向上。
rules.en: For a Po Jun that goes with the flow, a touch of Huo Xing or Qing Yang actually spurs you upwards.

rules.text: 叛逆的破軍見〔煞星〕多，人生太過坎坷時容易洩氣；這時看福德宮和遷移宮：福德好就靠精神力量求變，遷移好就靠轉換環境改善。
rules.en: A rebellious Po Jun with many malefics can lose heart when life gets too rough; then look to the Fortune and Travel palaces: if Fortune is strong, change through inner strength; if Travel is strong, improve things by changing your surroundings.
rules.edit: 「煞刑眾多」以三方四正同時見羊陀之一及火鈴之一近似；引擎冇天刑。

source.quote: 有时反主其人因人生太过坎坷而丧志

rules.text: 你的運勢像馬鞍：上升時會忽然受挫轉下，然後再升上去；起伏的幅度，就看順從與叛逆哪一面重。
rules.en: Your fortunes run like a saddle: on the way up a sudden setback turns them down, and then they climb again; how deep the dips go depends on whether the compliant or the rebellious side is stronger.
